sections.usagePolicy:
• Always credit with a link to the original video AND channel (at minimum in the description).
• Don't re-upload the full video or large portions as your own content.
• Don't monetize footage without explicit consent.
• Don't edit footage to misrepresent the original content or creator.
• Compilation, review, commentary, and reaction videos are OK — as long as you credit.
If in doubt, reach out via the social links or email in the description.
